predeclared_tolerance_before_results.rule: If max error exceeds this, say so; do not loosen.
predeclared_tolerance_before_results.compared_quantity: max abs of real and imag parts of all 4 entries of U_specified - U_numpy_eigh

closed_form_under_consideration.eigenvectors: if abs(c)>0: normalize([c, lam-a]) else I or swap if a>b
closed_form_under_consideration.known_instability: lam-a cancels when 0<|c|<<|a-b|; [c, lam-a] is then dominated by roundoff and V is not orthonormal

random.note: i.i.d. uniform; P(|delta|<1e-12) is negligible so this draw does not probe cancellation

stress_tiny_delta.purpose: probe abs(c)>0 branch near the diagonal special-case; required because the formula claims to handle any nonzero c

delta_magnitude_scan.note: delta==0 uses diagonal branch and passes; tiny nonzero fails until |delta| is large enough that lam-a is not roundoff

sign_independence.evidence: specified sign-independence max abs is 0 on all sets; numpy sign/phase independence is ~0; specified vs sign-flipped numpy still mismatches on failing cases by the same large amount, and V.T@V-I is O(0.1-1) not 0

diagnostic_stable_formulas_not_under_tes.note: Not the formula under consideration. Shown only to separate '2x2 closed form is impossible' from 'this eigenvector recipe is unstable'.
diagnostic_stable_formulas_not_under_tes.cosh_sinh_hypot: exp(-m dtau) * (cosh(r dtau) I - sinh(r dtau)/r * [[d,c],[c,-d]]) with r=hypot((a-b)/2,c), m=(a+b)/2, d=(a-b)/2
diagnostic_stable_formulas_not_under_tes.stable_eigvec: for each lam, take normalize([c,lam-a]) or normalize([lam-b,c]), whichever has larger Euclidean norm
diagnostic_stable_formulas_not_under_tes.stable_eigvec_grid_45_exceed_explanation: All 45 grid numeric_close failures of the diagnostic larger-norm eigenvector recipe are the 45 points with delta=0 and gap=0 (3 k x 3 t x 5 dtau). Both columns collapse to e1 because [c,lam-a]=[lam-b,c]=0. The specified formula handles this via the abs(c)==0 branch (V=I). Not used for the recommendation.

recommendation_reason_short: Specified normalize([c, lam-a]) closed form does not match Task-4 numpy.linalg.eigh within predeclared atol=1e-12, rtol=1e-10 for tiny nonzero delta (max abs error 1.21e2 on stress; 60/80 fail). Grid and uniform-200 pass the combined predicate but |delta| in ~[1e-14, 1e-4] fails even at ordinary parameters because abs(c)>0 skips the diagonal branch. Do not loosen. Use LAPACK (dsyev/zheev) to preserve Task-1/4 eigh semantics.

recommendation_reasons.exact_Task_1_semantics: Task-1/4 defines U via numpy.linalg.eigh on complex128 H. Specified closed form is algebraically equal in exact arithmetic but not in float64 for tiny nonzero delta, so it does not preserve Task-1 semantics at the repository tolerance.
recommendation_reasons.portability: LAPACK dsyev/zheev is the portable Fortran equivalent of numpy.linalg.eigh. A 2x2 closed form would be more portable (no LAPACK) but the formula as written is not numerically safe.
recommendation_reasons.reproducibility: U=V exp(-w dtau) V^H is unique; vendor LAPACK may change eigenvector signs/phases, which do not change U (confirmed). Specified V is not always an eigenbasis, so U is then wrong, not merely rephased.
recommendation_reasons.dependency: LAPACK is an extra dependency versus 20 lines of arithmetic. That saving is not worth breaking U for 0<|delta|<<|gap|.
recommendation_reasons.numerical_behavior: Grid (including delta=0 special case) max abs  error is ~1e-15. Tiny nonzero delta makes lam-a roundoff-dominated; V columns not orthonormal; U mixes the two exponentials; errors O(1) to O(100) when |dtau| is O(1) and eigenvalues are O(1).
recommendation_reasons.do_not_use_abs_c_gt_0_as_a_threshold: Python/Fortran abs(c)>0 is true for ~1e-16; the diagonal branch is therefore skipped exactly where it is needed.

raw_abs_vs_atol.note: Task-1/4 predicate is |d|<=atol+rtol*|ref|, not |d|<=atol alone. Uniform-200 raw max 3.49e-10 is on |U|~5.17e5 (relative ~7e-16) and still numeric_close. Tiny-delta stress fails the combined predicate.
